description: Land Title Settlement Department - Etamurungagoda, Marispaththuwa D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320315 and others
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, ownership details, extent, nature of land, and encumbrances) in various villages in the Kandy District. The content focuses on land ownership, title settlement, and property registration, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
